extraction_notes: The supplied PDF identifies the device as PNP General Purpose and the manufacturer as ANHUI FOSAN SEMICONDUCTOR TECHNOLOGY CO. , LTD.; manufacturer normalized to the requested identity FOSAN.

All three supplied pages were inspected for characteristic plots; pages 1 and 2 contain ratings and electrical-characteristics tables, and page 3 contains package dimensions. No usable curves were present, so curve extraction was not possible.
Electrical characteristics are headed TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted; this temperature is preserved in each extracted operating condition.
HFE1 and HFE2 are guaranteed minimum and maximum bounds, not typical values; both bounds are retained as separate points at each stated bias.
The datasheet does not tabulate Cobo or Cibo.
The datasheet does not state a revision identifier.
omission_reason: No usable characteristic curves are present in the supplied three-page PDF; only tables and package dimensions are provided. Cobo and Cibo are not tabulated.
